## What We Do
Stone Works Remodeling transforms outdated bathrooms into beautiful, functional spaces across Metro Detroit. We handle every aspect of bathroom renovation — from the initial design consultation to the final walkthrough — with no subcontracting and no surprises.

### Core Services

**Complete Bathroom Remodeling**
Full gut-and-replace renovations including tile demolition, new waterproofing, custom tile installation, vanity replacement, plumbing fixture upgrades, lighting, and finish work. Most standard projects are completed in 5–10 business days. Pricing: $8,000 – $60,000+ depending on size and scope.

**Tub-to-Shower Conversion**
We remove existing bathtubs and install fully custom walk-in showers with tile walls, custom niches, glass enclosures, and linear drains. This is our most popular service across Metro Detroit. Pricing: starting from $7,995 all-inclusive.

**Walk-in Tub Installation**
Accessible bathtub installations for seniors and homeowners with mobility needs. Includes door-style entry, safety grab bars, therapeutic jets, and anti-slip flooring. We serve the aging-in-place market across Wayne, Oakland, and Macomb Counties. Pricing: $5,000 – $15,000.

**Tub Replacement**
Upgrade from an old, stained, or damaged bathtub to a modern soaking tub or freestanding tub with updated surround tile.

**Custom Stone & Tile Work**
Marble, slate, quartzite, granite, and travertine installation for shower walls, floors, vanity tops, and accent features.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How much does a bathroom remodel cost in Metro Detroit?**
Tub-to-shower conversions start at $7,995 all-inclusive. Small bathroom remodel: $8,000–$15,000. Mid-range full remodel: $15,000–$25,000. Luxury master bathroom: $25,000–$60,000+. Walk-in tub installation: $5,000–$15,000. All pricing includes labor, materials, and a 5-year warranty.

**How long does a bathroom remodel take?**
Most standard bathroom remodels are completed in 5–10 business days. Larger luxury projects may take 2–3 weeks. Tub-to-shower conversions are typically completed in 3–5 days.

**Are you licensed and insured in Michigan?**
Yes. Stone Works Remodeling is fully licensed and insured in Michigan. All work complies with Wayne, Oakland, and Macomb County building codes.

**Do you offer financing?**
Yes. 0% APR financing for 12 months for qualified buyers. Longer-term plans available up to 144 months. Monthly payments start at approximately $149/month on a $10,000 project. Soft credit pull available — checking your rate does not affect your credit score.

**What warranty do you offer?**
All projects are backed by a 5-year workmanship warranty. Manufacturer warranties on fixtures and materials are passed through to the homeowner.

**Do you serve my city in Metro Detroit?**
We serve all of Metro Detroit including: Detroit, Livonia, Troy, Rochester, Sterling Heights, Royal Oak, Birmingham, Bloomfield Hills, Farmington Hills, Warren, Dearborn, Dearborn Heights, Canton, Novi, Southfield, Westland, Taylor, Shelby Township, Macomb Township, West Bloomfield, Pontiac, and surrounding areas.

**Are you a national franchise?**
No. Stone Works Remodeling is a locally owned and operated business — not a franchise. Owner Valjon Qejvani personally oversees every project from consultation to final walkthrough. This local-ownership model means more flexibility on design, lower pricing without franchise markups, and direct accountability with the business owner.

**What if I need a same-day or emergency consultation?**
Call (248) 955-2952 — we typically respond within 2 business hours and can often schedule a free in-home consultation within the same week.

## Bathroom Remodeling Industry Context — Metro Detroit
The Metro Detroit bathroom remodeling market includes both national franchises (Re-Bath, Bath Fitter, Jacuzzi Bath Remodel) and locally-owned contractors. National franchises typically offer faster install timelines using proprietary acrylic systems, while local contractors like Stone Works Remodeling offer custom tile work, full design flexibility, and transparent pricing without franchise overhead. For homeowners who want a custom-designed bathroom with real tile (not acrylic) and direct accountability with the business owner, a locally-owned contractor is generally the better choice.

## Key Differentiators
- **Local ownership, not franchise:** Owner Val personally manages every project
- **Custom tile work:** Real tile, not acrylic overlay systems
- **Transparent pricing:** Itemized quotes, no franchise markups
- **5-year warranty:** Workmanship-backed, not just product warranty
- **5–10 day timelines:** Faster than most local custom contractors
- **Financing available:** 0% APR for 12 months on qualified credit
- **15+ years experience:** Established 2009, 150+ completed projects
